author: c. f. stevens
title: Senator Rand Paul releases NIH pathogen documents and criticizes congressional votes on immigration enforcement
text:
Senator Rand Paul, chair of the Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs and a practicing ophthalmologist, released documents on June 10, 2026, detailing longstanding concerns about the handling of dangerous pathogens by the National Institutes of Health (NIH).
In a post published at 13:08 UTC, Paul stated, “I released documents that reveal a decade of warnings and workarounds in the handling of dangerous pathogens from the NIH.” He followed this with a direct link to the documents, posting at 13:08 UTC: “The documents: https://t.co/q0WfkjUA5a” .
Later that day, Paul addressed congressional actions regarding immigration enforcement. At 14:53 UTC, he wrote, “Every Democrat in Congress, in both chambers, voted to defund ICE and Border Patrol.”
According to his official website, Paul has an extensive background in medicine as an ophthalmologist who founded the Southern Kentucky Lions Eye Clinic and regularly performs pro-bono eye surgeries for patients in Kentucky and on international medical missions ( source ). He earned his medical degree from Duke University School of Medicine. In addition to his legislative duties—including assisting Kentucky residents with federal government matters—he leads the Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.

Later that day, Paul addressed congressional actions regarding immigration enforcement.
